description: This Java source file defines the StorageProviderFragment class, an Android Fragment that manages user login status and interacts with a document content provider, including toggling login state and notifying the system of content changes.

classes.name: StorageProviderFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that handles user login toggling for a cloud storage provider, manages UI options, and notifies the content resolver of data changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, restoring login state and indicating it has options menu items.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, updating the login/logout menu item title based on current login state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling login and notifying the content provider about root changes.

methods.name: toggleLogin
methods.description: Switches the login state and logs the action.

methods.name: writeLoginValue
methods.description: Saves the current login state into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: readLoginValue
methods.description: Retrieves the login state from SharedPreferences.
